Contributions to percent change of chain-linked volume measures

Source: R/contributions.R
chain_contrib.Rd

Exact contributions of the components to the percent change of a total chain-linked with the annual overlap ("ao") or the one-quarter overlap ("oqo") technique (IMF QNA Manual, chapter 8, example 8.9).

Usage

chain_contrib(
  vo,
  cp,
  vo_total = NULL,
  cp_total = NULL,
  method = c("ao", "oqo"),
  type = c("period", "yoy", "annual"),
  base_year = NULL,
  extra = NULL,
  pi = NULL,
  overlap_prices = c("year_prices", "current_prices")
)

Arguments

vo

Chain volume measures (in monetary terms) of the components (ts or mts), as returned by chain_link() or chain_laspeyres() with output = "measure". If vo_total is NULL, the last column of vo is the total (as returned by chain_laspeyres()).

cp

Current prices of the components (same number of columns as vo, without the total). It must cover the base year.

vo_total

Chain volume measure of the total (ts). It cannot be deduced from vo because chain measures are not additive. By default (NULL), the last column of vo is used (and the last column of cp is the total of the current prices, if cp has one more column than the components).

cp_total

Current prices of the total. By default, the sum of cp (only valid if cp contains all the components).

method

Chain-linking technique used to compute vo and vo_total: "ao" (annual overlap) or "oqo" (one-quarter overlap, built as in the manual: see chain_laspeyres()).

type

Growth to decompose: "period" (default) for the growth over the previous period (quarter or month), "yoy" for the growth over the same period of the previous year, "annual" for the growth of the annual sums. For method = "oqo", the contributions to annual growth are only defined from the second year (the annual sum of the base year is not defined).

base_year

Reference year of the chain measures. By default, the year before the start of vo (or the first year of cp, if later).

extra

Additional columns: "total" adds the growth of the total, and "residual" the difference between this growth and the sum of the contributions (non-additivity). Default: none.

pi

Price indices of the components over the previous year (previous year average = 100), needed for method = "oqo" to value the overlap period at the average prices of the year (see cp_pi2cy()). If NULL, cp must already be valued at the average prices of the year (cp_pi2cy()).

overlap_prices

Only for method = "oqo": prices used to value the overlap period when vo was computed, "year_prices" (average prices of the year, default) or "current_prices" (own current prices): see chain_laspeyres(). With "current_prices", cp is used as it is and pi is not needed.

Value

A ts (or mts) of contributions, in percentage points, with the same columns as vo (followed by Total and/or Residual). It has the span of vo (extended to complete years), with NA when a contribution cannot be computed (e.g. the first periods).

Details

Let \(x_t\) be the chain volume measure of a component and \(z_t\) the one of the total. Within year \(y\), the total is exactly \(z_t = \sum_i \rho_{i,y-1} x_{i,t}\), where \(\rho_{i,y-1}\) is the relative price (price of the component / price of the total) of the previous year:

  • method = "ao": \(\rho_y = (cp^x_y / x_y) / (cp^z_y / z_y)\) with annual sums;

  • method = "oqo": the same ratio computed on the overlap period (the last period of the year), with the values at the average prices of the year (cp_pi2cy()). In the reference year, the ratio is 1 (the first year is linked with the annual overlap technique).

The contribution to the growth between a period \(s\) and a period \(t\) (previous period, same period of the previous year, or previous year) is $$100 \left[ \frac{(x_t - x_s)\rho_{y(t)-1}}{z_s} + \left(\frac{x_s}{z_s} - a_{y(t)-1}\right)(\rho_{y(t)-1} - \rho_{y(s)-1})\right]$$ where \(a_y = x_y / z_y\) (annual overlap) or the share of the overlap period (one-quarter overlap). The second term is zero when \(s\) and \(t\) are in the same year, and for the annual overlap technique it is also zero for annual growth. For the growth over the previous period with the annual overlap technique, it gives the formulas of the example 8.9. Contributions add up to the growth of the total (up to the inconsistencies of the data: see extra = "residual").

For the annual overlap technique, type = "period" and type = "annual" are the equations (29) and (30) of the manual (paragraphs 8.86 and 8.87, example 8.9) and type = "yoy" is the equation (31) (paragraph 8.88).

For the one-quarter overlap technique, the manual (footnote 35) applies the same formulas with the annual deflators, but the contributions are then not exactly additive. With method = "oqo", the deflators of the overlap period are used, so that contributions add up exactly. The formulas of the manual can be obtained with method = "ao" applied to the one-quarter overlap measures.

As recommended by the manual (paragraph 8.90), the contribution of a variable that can be negative, zero or positive (such as changes in inventories) should be calculated residually: the difference between the contribution of the aggregate that includes it and the contributions of the other components.

Series can be monthly: the "overlap period" is then the last month of the year.

See also

chain_laspeyres(), chain_link(), chain_discrepancy(), fisher_contrib()

Examples

# Chain volume measures of the components and of the total (last column)
x <- chain_laspeyres(imf_cp, imf_pi, method = "ao", base_year = 2010,
           output = "measure")
# Contributions to the growth over the previous quarter
chain_contrib(x, imf_cp, method = "ao", extra = c("total", "residual"))
#>                 A           B       Total      Residual
#> 2011 Q1        NA          NA          NA            NA
#> 2011 Q2 0.7018869 -0.80753250 -0.10564556  1.110223e-15
#> 2011 Q3 0.8759418 -0.83843806  0.03750373  2.386980e-14
#> 2011 Q4 0.5916476 -0.28074005  0.31090759 -1.265654e-14
#> 2012 Q1 0.2482781 -0.04138817  0.20688994 -3.441691e-14
#> 2012 Q2 1.8170839 -1.83456773 -0.01748383  1.110223e-15
#> 2012 Q3 2.6734251 -2.15776489  0.51566023 -1.332268e-15
#> 2012 Q4 6.6147888 -5.70140470  0.91338411  7.993606e-15
#> 2013 Q1 2.0816590 -1.07701699  1.00464199  3.774758e-15
#> 2013 Q2 3.4403109 -2.88707439  0.55323650 -3.730349e-14
#> 2013 Q3 2.1362808 -2.15630586 -0.02002510  2.042810e-14
#> 2013 Q4 0.9660243 -1.10929020 -0.14326595 -5.773160e-15
# Contributions to the growth over the same quarter of the previous year
chain_contrib(x, imf_cp, method = "ao", type = "yoy")
#>                 A          B
#> 2011 Q1        NA         NA
#> 2011 Q2        NA         NA
#> 2011 Q3        NA         NA
#> 2011 Q4        NA         NA
#> 2012 Q1  2.419471  -1.969565
#> 2012 Q2  3.547655  -3.009097
#> 2012 Q3  5.357150  -4.338040
#> 2012 Q4 11.409099  -9.783259
#> 2013 Q1 13.260886 -10.825998
#> 2013 Q2 14.970646 -11.951039
#> 2013 Q3 14.419294 -11.948717
#> 2013 Q4  8.707144  -7.309522
# Contributions to the growth of the annual sums
chain_contrib(x, imf_cp, method = "ao", type = "annual")
#> Time Series:
#> Start = 2011 
#> End = 2013 
#> Frequency = 1 
#>              A          B
#> 2011  2.871313  -2.139421
#> 2012  5.687434  -4.778567
#> 2013 12.826798 -10.499269

# One-quarter overlap
x_oqo <- chain_laspeyres(imf_cp, imf_pi, method = "oqo", base_year = 2010,
             output = "measure")
chain_contrib(x_oqo, imf_cp, method = "oqo", type = "yoy", pi = imf_pi)
#>                 A          B
#> 2011 Q1        NA         NA
#> 2011 Q2        NA         NA
#> 2011 Q3        NA         NA
#> 2011 Q4        NA         NA
#> 2012 Q1  2.396658  -1.986400
#> 2012 Q2  3.524103  -3.025228
#> 2012 Q3  5.332544  -4.353307
#> 2012 Q4 11.381924  -9.796196
#> 2013 Q1 13.147118 -10.927676
#> 2013 Q2 14.849443 -12.046512
#> 2013 Q3 14.294159 -12.039103
#> 2013 Q4  8.581168  -7.396810
# One-quarter overlap, overlap quarter at its own current prices
x_cp <- chain_laspeyres(
  imf_cp, imf_pi, method = "oqo", base_year = 2010,
   overlap_prices = "current_prices", output = "measure"
)
chain_contrib(x_cp, imf_cp, method = "oqo", type = "yoy",
        overlap_prices = "current_prices")
#>                 A          B
#> 2011 Q1        NA         NA
#> 2011 Q2        NA         NA
#> 2011 Q3        NA         NA
#> 2011 Q4        NA         NA
#> 2012 Q1  2.236542  -2.266425
